selection_rule: For an arbitrary timeline time T (seconds, relative to stream start): seek to the latest keyframe with presentation timestamp <= T (or the first keyframe in the file if T is before it), flush the decoder, then decode forward in presentation order. The SELECTED FRAME is the last decoded frame whose PTS <= T. If a subsequently decoded frame has PTS > T, its timestamp is reported as next_pts_s, and duration_s = next_pts_s - selected_pts_s approximates the display duration of the selected frame. Boundary handling: (1) if T is before the PTS of the very first frame in the file, the first frame is selected and fallback=clamped_to_first_frame; (2) if T is at or after the last decodable frame's PTS, that last frame is selected and fallback=clamped_to_last_frame, with next_pts_s unavailable. We do NOT assume frame_index = floor(T * nominal_fps); the selection is always based on decoded PTS values, which is what makes it correct for VFR content and for streams with a non-zero start_time.

stream_summary.cfr_vfr_basis: Measured 119 decoded frame intervals: mean=0.033333s, stddev=0.000000s, coefficient_of_variation=0.0000 (threshold 0.02). Container avg_frame_rate=30/1, r_frame_rate=30/1 were NOT used as the sole basis.
